title: Extended Equipment Warranty Plans — Schedule of Renewal, Non-Renewal Notice, Cancellation Refund and Transfer Terms
content:
Schedule of the renewal, cancellation and transfer terms of the six tiers of the Extended Equipment Warranty Plans.

## A. Renewal terms

| Tier | Renews automatically at term end | Renewal window opens this many days before term end | Non-renewal notice must be received this many days before term end | Escalation of the plan price at renewal | Plan age beyond which a renewal needs a fresh condition inspection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Manufacturer Warranty Registration | No | 30 calendar days | 15 calendar days | 0.0 percent | 60 calendar months |
| Parts Protection Plan | Yes | 45 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 6.0 percent | 36 calendar months |
| Parts & Labor Protection Plan | Yes | 45 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 5.5 percent | 36 calendar months |
| Compressor Coverage Plan | Yes | 60 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 5.0 percent | 48 calendar months |
| Major Component Protection Plan | Yes | 60 calendar days | 45 calendar days | 4.5 percent | 48 calendar months |
| Total Equipment Protection Plan | No | 90 calendar days | 60 calendar days | 4.0 percent | 60 calendar months |

## B. Cancellation terms

| Tier | Written notice before a cancellation takes effect | How an unused term is refunded | Administration fee deducted from a cancellation refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| Manufacturer Warranty Registration | 15 calendar days | No refund | 0 USD |
| Parts Protection Plan | 30 calendar days | Short rate | 75 USD |
| Parts & Labor Protection Plan | 30 calendar days | Short rate | 95 USD |
| Compressor Coverage Plan | 30 calendar days | Pro rata | 125 USD |
| Major Component Protection Plan | 45 calendar days | Pro rata | 150 USD |
| Total Equipment Protection Plan | 60 calendar days | Pro rata | 250 USD |

The refund basis takes one of three values: no refund, pro rata, or short rate.

## C. Transfer on sale of the building

| Tier | Plan transfers to a new building owner | Transfer fee |
|---|---|---|
| Manufacturer Warranty Registration | Yes | 0 USD |
| Parts Protection Plan | No | 0 USD |
| Parts & Labor Protection Plan | Yes | 195 USD |
| Compressor Coverage Plan | Yes | 250 USD |
| Major Component Protection Plan | Yes | 250 USD |
| Total Equipment Protection Plan | Yes | 0 USD |

## Notes to the schedule

1. Two tiers do not renew automatically: the Manufacturer Warranty Registration and the Total Equipment Protection Plan. The other four do.
2. The escalation percent is the increase applied to the plan price at renewal; on the Manufacturer Warranty Registration it is 0.0 percent, so the renewed price equals the prior price.
3. The Parts Protection Plan is the one tier that does not transfer to a new building owner; of the tiers that do, the Manufacturer Warranty Registration and the Total Equipment Protection Plan carry a 0 USD transfer fee.
4. Refund basis by tier: no refund on the Manufacturer Warranty Registration; short rate on the Parts Protection Plan and the Parts & Labor Protection Plan; pro rata on the Compressor Coverage Plan, the Major Component Protection Plan and the Total Equipment Protection Plan.
